done_when: on every device (JIS-NB, JIS-NUC, DESKTOP-F7IU69N) sync.py where --all shows no UNSHIPPED row except lane trees and the live tree, and each device sent its STATION done line
goal: No worktree on any station holds work that is not on origin; every clean, pushed tree is removed.
note: OPERATOR QUOTE: I think you should create a task for this. And your task it for all stations. So going forward, station would mean a device, with a login. / And I meant broadcast. You have to broadcast it.
scope_in: the worktrees of the repo on the station's own device (git worktree list)
scope_out: the live tree (.mts_live), lane trees mts-dsa/mts-relay/mts-app (their owners ship them), other sessions' running trees
steps: for each UNSHIPPED tree: git -C <tree> status --short and git -C <tree> log --oneline origin/fast-track..HEAD; read what it is
real work (commits, notes, code): from inside that tree run python scripts/dev/sync.py ship (its own branch merges via PR/fast-track as usual)
runtime, order or account data, scratch: never commit (public repo); leave it, or python scripts/dev/sync.py discard <tree> (saves it to Dumps/wt_rescue/ first)
python scripts/dev/sync.py tidy --apply (removes only clean, pushed, idle trees), then where --all again
python scripts/dev/mts_signal.py send "STATION <device>/<login> worktrees: <n> shipped, <n> discarded, <n> left (why)" --to all --kind done
tests: none (run task); proof = where --all output before and after, pasted in the done line or the session's last reply
title: Every station: save unshipped worktree work to origin, then tidy
